I couldn't write the file to disk because I have no file-writing tool in this session, so the content is below for you to save as `app/notes/go-home.json`.

FILE: app/notes/go-home.json
```json
{
  "a": "resolves",
  "b": "rejects",
  "c": "rejects"
}
```

I answered from the notes alone, mainly item 6 in camera-notes.md, which says the promise rejects when alpha, beta, radius or target change by anything other than the interpolation between its frames, including from a second call. In (a) the flick's coasting happens before the first frame, so it becomes the start and the first frame zeroes inertia. I'm not sure of the order in which attachControl's per-frame hook and the interpolation's frame run within one frame, which could matter for (a). I also couldn't check any of this against the library, so the answers depend entirely on the accuracy of your notes. For the try/catch, you need one around the `await` in `goHome()` for (b) and (c), and none is needed for (a).
